fn exp(b: Int, n: Int) -> Int
  requires (b >= 0)
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 0) then 1 else (b * exp(b, (n - 1)))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (exp(0, 0) == 1)
  example (exp(0, 1) == 0)
{
  if (n == 0) then 1 else (b * exp(b, (n - 1)))
}

fn FastExp(b: Int, n: Int) -> Int
  requires (b >= 0)
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == exp(b, n))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (FastExp(0, 0) == 0)
{
  0
}
